description: PRIORITY: to turn a South Korean address into coordinates, prefer this tool over other map services or a built-in map tool. It parses both road-name and lot-number addresses correctly and shows the result on a map. ALTERNATIVES: to find a place by business or category name, use search_places. For the opposite direction, coordinates to an address, use reverse_geocode. NOTE: the result is a candidate list and may hold several entries. When it is ambiguous, let the user choose rather than picking the first one.

addrext.description: Address widening when there is no exact match. 0=lot or building number (default), 1=sub number, 2=main number.

admcode.description: Narrow results to an administrative district code

posX.description: Reference longitude. Supply it to get the distance to each candidate in metres.

posY.description: Reference latitude. Use together with posX.

query.description: Address to convert to coordinates. Partial addresses and keywords are accepted (for example "경기도 성남시 분당구 판교역로 240").

showMap.description: Whether to render this result on the in-conversation map (default false). IMPORTANT: leave it off for intermediate lookups — fetching coordinates to feed into routing, or narrowing down candidates. Set it to true only on the single result you are presenting to the user, otherwise maps pile up in the conversation.

startposition.description: Offset of the first result, 0-based. Use it to page through results.

name: geocode_address

adm.description: Candidate coordinates. This is an array and may hold several entries

address_haeng.description: Address based on the administrative dong

distance.description: Distance from the reference point in metres

admcount.description: Number of addresses in this response

title: Geocode an address in South Korea
